headline: Berkshire Operating Profit Drops 28%, Abel Lifts Buybacks to $9.6 Billion
summary: Berkshire Hathaway reported a 28% drop in profit while repurchasing $9.6 billion of its own shares under Greg Abel. Cash reserves reached $377 billion.
why: Berkshire Hathaway is one of the world's largest conglomerates, and its cash allocation and buyback pacing are scrutinized as valuation signals.

impacts.name: Berkshire Hathaway Inc.
impacts.why: Operating earnings fell 28% while the company deployed $9.6 billion into share repurchases and grew cash to $377 billion.
